{{Box|title=Did you know…|content=
* …that the [[Ash Oath]] bears '''ten seals — some say eleven'''?
* …that an old children's rhyme counts ''"…eight, nine, ten, and one who left"'' — so that children count to eleven without knowing it?
* …that the [[The seat of power|seat of power]] is called '''Ederhamn''' in the Chronicle, '''Elvestad''' in the Songs, and '''Ederstad''' in the oldest, burned fragments — and that no one can say why an inland city is named a ''haven''?
* …that the great bell of [[House Whitehart]] has '''no clapper''', yet the old ones swear it tolls in still air?
* …that [[House Tidebreaker]]'s lighthouse does not shine toward the harbor, but ''out over the [[the Sleeping Sea|Sleeping Sea]]'', as if calling home what never comes back?
* …that the rivers of the [[the Banner-lands|Banner-lands]] are deliberately '''unnamed''' — "draw the water, omit the quarrel"?
* …that [[House Stormrider]]'s seat, [[the Hub]], has '''no wall, only roads''' — and stands on the old battlefield itself?
* …that the door of [[Oath-hold]]'s Guest Hall '''cannot be barred''' — and that the oldest line on its Wall of Shame is nameless?
* …that [[House Phoenix]] keeps '''no chronicle''' — it writes plans, not memories?
* …that in [[Forge Gap]] there are '''no ruins''' — only half-finished things?
* …that [[Plate I]]'s scale bar reads: ''"a hundred leagues, more or less — no two charts agree"''?
* …that Whitehart children learn their dead's names '''before their living relatives' faces'''?
}}

{{Box|title=About Aurefold|content=
'''Aurefold''' is a low-fantasy series in mystic realism by the author of ''[[The Bell of Silence]]''. Ten Great Houses have ruled the [[the Banner-lands|Banner-lands]] since the [[War of the Unification]] ended four hundred years ago — and each house is less a family than a philosophy of leadership. The question the books ask is never ''which house is good''. It is: '''which house would you follow?'''

This wiki documents the world in the historian's voice: ''where the sources disagree, the disagreement is kept.''
}}
{{Box|title=Contributing|content=
This wiki grows with the books. Start with the [[Help:Style guide|style guide]], then use the article templates:
* {{tl|Infobox character}} · {{tl|Infobox faction}} · {{tl|Infobox place}}
* Quotes with {{tl|Quote}}, section boxes with {{tl|Box}}
* Mark scaffolded filler with {{tl|Placeholder}}
Nothing from [[:Category:Development]] may be cited as canon.
